items.title: Managing Patients With Hypermobility Disorders: They've Seen You, but Have You Seen Them?
items.summary: This editorial discusses the management of hypermobility spectrum disorders (HSD) and hypermobile Ehlers-Danlos syndrome (hEDS) in musculoskeletal physical therapy, noting that despite a lack of high-quality randomized trials, international classification updates and emerging consensus offer sufficient guidance for practice.
items.curatedReason: 对于高活动度障碍（HSD/hEDS）患者，这份专家意见提醒你，别再过度被动治疗，要用基于共识的积极管理策略。虽然高质量 RCT 缺乏，但共识更新足以指导临床，强调 PT 在多学科团队中的核心作用。
items.titleZh: 高活动度障碍患者管理：他们寻求过你，但你真正“看”懂他们了吗？
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评讨论了肌肉骨骼物理治疗中高活动度谱系障碍 (HSD) 和高活动度 Ehlers-Danlos 综合征 (hEDS) 的管理，指出尽管高质量随机试验有限，但国际分类更新和新兴共识为临床实践提供了足够指导。
items.curatedReasonEn: For patients with hypermobility disorders (HSD/hEDS), this editorial reminds you to move beyond overly passive treatments and adopt consensus-based active management strategies. Although high-quality RCTs are limited, updated consensus provides sufficient guidance for clinical practice, highlighting PT's central role in the multidisciplinary team.
items.journal: The Journal of orthopaedic and sports physical therapy

items.title: Moving Forward Together. Part 6: Transforming Musculoskeletal Health Physical Therapy for Indigenous Peoples-A Call to Action.

items.titleZh: 携手前行。第六部分：为原住民群体改变肌肉骨骼健康物理治疗——行动呼吁。
items.summaryZh: 《携手前行》系列第六部分呼吁肌肉骨骼物理治疗师、组织和系统通过将原住民健康融入临床实践、研究和教育，以改善原住民的护理和结果。
items.curatedReasonEn: This call from the JOSPT series urges you to address musculoskeletal health equity for Indigenous Peoples. As a physical therapist, your clinical practice, research, and education should actively integrate this perspective, becoming an ally and advocate for Indigenous communities.

items.title: Contralesional plantar peripheral electrical stimulation combined with contralesional posterior parietal cortex repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation promotes lower-limb motor recovery in stroke patients with hemiparesis: a randomized, double-blind, factorial controlled trial
items.summary: This randomized, double-blind, factorial controlled trial protocol investigates if contralesional plantar peripheral electrical stimulation combined with contralesional posterior parietal cortex repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation promotes lower-limb motor recovery in stroke patients with hemiparesis.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后偏瘫患者的下肢运动功能，可以通过健侧足底外周电刺激结合健侧顶叶重复经颅磁刺激来协同促进。在设计高级神经康复干预时，可以考虑这种多模式联合方案。
items.titleZh: 健侧足底外周电刺激联合健侧顶叶重复经颅磁刺激协同促进卒中偏瘫患者下肢运动恢复：一项随机、双盲、析因对照试验
items.summaryZh: 这项随机、双盲、析因对照试验协议研究了健侧足底外周电刺激结合健侧顶叶重复经颅磁刺激是否能促进卒中偏瘫患者的下肢运动功能恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: Lower-limb motor recovery in stroke patients with hemiparesis can be synergistically promoted by combining contralesional plantar peripheral electrical stimulation with contralesional posterior parietal cortex repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation. Consider this multimodal combination when designing advanced neurorehabilitation interventions.

items.curatedReasonEn: Combined resistance, balance, and aerobic training significantly improves strength, mobility, balance, and quality of life in older adults with sarcopenia. items.title: Delaying Early Morning Training Time in Swimmers: Effects on Sleep, Recovery and Performance—A Randomized Controlled Trial
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial protocol investigates whether delaying early morning training time in swimmers affects sleep, recovery, and performance.

items.curatedReasonEn: Delaying early morning training effectively improves sleep, recovery, and performance in swimmers. If you are training adolescent or adult competitive swimmers, especially those with sleep deficits, consider incorporating this strategy into their training schedule.

items.title: Sarcopenia as an independent associated factor for urinary incontinence in adults: a systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies
items.summary: A systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies found sarcopenia to be an independent associated factor for urinary incontinence in adults.
items.curatedReason: 肌少症与成人尿失禁独立相关，这意味着筛查肌少症可作为尿失禁风险评估的一部分。在老年或肌少症患者中，应考虑将肌力训练纳入尿失禁干预策略。
items.titleZh: 肌少症作为成人尿失禁独立相关因素：一项观察性研究的系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项对观察性研究的系统综述和荟萃分析发现，肌少症是成人尿失禁的一个独立相关因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: Sarcopenia is independently associated with urinary incontinence in adults, suggesting sarcopenia screening could be part of incontinence risk assessment. For older adults or those with sarcopenia, consider incorporating strength training into incontinence management strategies.
items.limitation: 这是一项观察性研究的系统综述和荟萃分析，无法确定因果关系，且存在潜在的异质性。

items.curatedReasonEn: The recovery effects of post-exercise cold-water immersion (CWI) are temperature-dependent. When recommending or utilizing CWI for athletic recovery, you must pay attention to water temperature parameters to achieve optimal results. Do not treat all 'cold water' as the same.

items.curatedReasonEn: A 12-week unstable surfaces resistance training program improves muscle stiffness, co-activation, and balance in older individuals. When designing fall prevention and functional training for older patients, you should include unstable surface training as an effective option.

items.title: Functional performance and blood pressure responses to online versus in-person multicomponent training in inactive older women: randomized controlled trial
items.summary: This randomized controlled trial protocol compares functional performance and blood pressure responses to online versus in-person multicomponent training in inactive older women.

items.curatedReasonEn: Early postoperative functional exercise adherence is associated with 3-month hip functional recovery in older adults after femoral neck fracture surgery. This underscores the importance of early patient education and support for adherence.

items.title: Lower-limb rate of torque development, but not peak torque, is associated with balance performance in older adults with and without Parkinson’s disease: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: This cross-sectional study found that lower-limb rate of torque development, but not peak torque, is associated with balance performance in older adults with and without Parkinson’s disease.

items.curatedReasonEn: Lower-limb rate of torque development, not peak torque, is associated with balance performance in older adults with and without Parkinson's disease. items.titleZh: ACL 重建术后一年单腿跳远时大腿肌肉共同激活及其与二维膝关节屈曲评分的关系：一项横断面研究

items.curatedReasonEn: Thigh muscle co-activation one year post-ACL reconstruction is associated with 2D knee flexion scores. items.limitation: 作为一项横断面研究，无法确定因果关系，且仅在术后一年进行评估，缺乏长期随访数据。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional study, it cannot establish causality and only assesses at one year post-surgery, lacking long-term follow-up data.

items.title: Musculoskeletal Stretching and Arterial Stiffness: Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Acute and Longitudinal Interventions
items.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis protocol investigates the acute and longitudinal effects of musculoskeletal stretching on arterial stiffness.
items.curatedReason: 肌肉骨骼拉伸可能有助于降低动脉僵硬度，进而降低心血管疾病风险。你可以在开具运动处方时，将拉伸视为一种有益的辅助手段，尤其是在那些存在心血管风险的患者身上。
items.titleZh: 肌肉骨骼拉伸与动脉僵硬度：急性和长期干预的系统综述与荟萃分析协议
items.summaryZh: 这项系统综述和荟萃分析协议调查了肌肉骨骼拉伸对动脉僵硬度的急性和长期影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Musculoskeletal stretching likely helps reduce arterial stiffness, potentially lowering cardiovascular disease risk. Consider incorporating stretching as a beneficial adjunct in your exercise prescriptions, particularly for patients with cardiovascular risk factors.
items.limitation: 这是一项协议发表，目前尚未发布最终研究结果，因此无法评估其最终疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and final results are not yet published, so definitive efficacy cannot be assessed.

items.title: Prosthetics & Orthotics, Prosthetic Devices, & Therapeutic Shoes
items.summary: CMS outlines Medicare Part B coverage for Prosthetics & Orthotics, Prosthetic Devices, Therapeutic Shoes, and DMEPOS, including conditions for coverage and replacement.
items.curatedReason: CMS 页面提供了关于假肢、矫形器、糖尿病治疗鞋和 DMEPOS（耐用医疗设备、假肢、矫形器和耗材）的 Medicare 报销政策概述。这直接关系到你在美国执业时为患者推荐和获取这些辅助设备的方式，需要你仔细阅读并遵守。
items.titleZh: 假肢与矫形器、假肢装置及治疗鞋的 CMS 报销政策
items.summaryZh: CMS 概述了 Medicare Part B 对假肢、矫形器、假肢装置、治疗鞋和 DMEPOS 的覆盖范围，包括覆盖条件和更换规定。
items.curatedReasonEn: The CMS page provides an overview of Medicare reimbursement policies for prosthetics, orthotics, therapeutic shoes, and DMEPOS (Durable Medical Equipment, Prosthetics, Orthotics, and Supplies). This directly impacts how you recommend and procure these assistive devices for patients in U.S. practice, requiring careful reading and adherence.

items.title: The effect of different intensities of aerobic exercise on neurorepair based on BDNF, PI3K, and Akt signaling pathways after ischemic stroke: a narrative review
items.summary: This narrative review explores the effect of different intensities of aerobic exercise on neurorepair after ischemic stroke, focusing on BDNF, PI3K, and Akt signaling pathways.
items.curatedReason: 有氧运动对缺血性卒中后的神经修复作用，可能通过 BDNF、PI3K 和 Akt 信号通路介导。虽然是叙述性综述，但它为你理解不同强度有氧运动的潜在机制提供了理论框架。
items.titleZh: 不同强度有氧运动对缺血性卒中后基于 BDNF、PI3K 和 Akt 信号通路的神经修复作用：一项叙述性综述
items.summaryZh: 这篇叙述性综述探讨了不同强度有氧运动对缺血性卒中后神经修复的影响，重点关注 BDNF、PI3K 和 Akt 信号通路。
items.curatedReasonEn: Aerobic exercise's neurorepair effects after ischemic stroke may be mediated via BDNF, PI3K, and Akt signaling pathways. While a narrative review, it offers a theoretical framework for understanding the potential mechanisms of different aerobic exercise intensities.
items.limitation: 作为叙述性综述，可能存在选择偏倚，且缺乏系统性证据综合。
items.limitationEn: As a narrative review, it may be subject to selection bias and lacks systematic evidence synthesis.
items.journal: Bulletin of Faculty of Physical Therapy

items.title: Neural mechanisms underlying loss of functional independence after stroke: EEG evidence of impaired motor-to-sensory directed connectivity on the affected side
items.summary: This research protocol investigates the neural mechanisms underlying loss of functional independence after stroke, with EEG evidence suggesting impaired motor-to-sensory directed connectivity on the affected side.
items.curatedReason: 卒中后功能独立性丧失的神经机制，可能与患侧运动-感觉定向连接受损有关。这项研究为你理解卒中后功能障碍的复杂神经生理学提供了新的视角。
items.titleZh: 卒中后功能独立性丧失的神经机制：患侧运动-感觉定向连接受损的脑电图证据
items.summaryZh: 这项研究协议探讨了卒中后功能独立性丧失的神经机制，脑电图证据表明患侧运动-感觉定向连接受损。
items.curatedReasonEn: Neural mechanisms underlying loss of functional independence after stroke may involve impaired motor-to-sensory directed connectivity on the affected side. This research offers new perspectives on the complex neurophysiology of post-stroke functional deficits.
items.limitation: 这是一项协议发表，目前尚未发布最终研究结果，因此无法评估其最终疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and final results are not yet published, so definitive efficacy cannot be assessed.

items.title: A bayesian inference and neural network model for predicting physical fitness consumption in table tennis athletes
items.summary: This research protocol details a Bayesian inference and neural network model for predicting physical fitness consumption in table tennis athletes.
items.curatedReason: 预测乒乓球运动员体能消耗的贝叶斯推理和神经网络模型，可以为训练负荷的科学管理提供支持。如果你在为竞技运动员提供康复或体能训练指导，这类 AI 模型可能在个性化训练优化中有用武之地。
items.titleZh: 预测乒乓球运动员体能消耗的贝叶斯推理和神经网络模型
items.summaryZh: 这项研究协议详细介绍了一种用于预测乒乓球运动员体能消耗的贝叶斯推理和神经网络模型。
items.curatedReasonEn: A Bayesian inference and neural network model for predicting physical fitness consumption in table tennis athletes can support the scientific management of training load. If you provide rehabilitation or fitness coaching for competitive athletes, such AI models might be useful for optimizing individualized training.
items.limitation: 这是一项协议发表，目前尚未发布最终研究结果，因此无法评估其最终疗效。
items.limitationEn: This is a study protocol, and final results are not yet published, so definitive efficacy cannot be assessed.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: A participatory fall-prevention education program (APREAL) for older inpatients in integrated nursing care wards: a quasi-experimental study
items.summary: This quasi-experimental study found a participatory fall-prevention education program (APREAL) for older inpatients in integrated nursing care wards to be beneficial.
items.curatedReason: 参与式防跌倒教育项目对老年住院患者有益。在综合护理病房中，你应考虑实施这类以患者为中心的防跌倒干预措施，以提高老年患者的安全。
items.titleZh: 参与式防跌倒教育项目（APREAL）对综合护理病房老年住院患者的影响：一项准实验研究
items.summaryZh: 这项准实验研究发现，参与式防跌倒教育项目（APREAL）对综合护理病房的老年住院患者有益。
items.curatedReasonEn: A participatory fall-prevention education program is beneficial for older inpatients. In integrated nursing care wards, you should consider implementing such patient-centered fall prevention interventions to enhance safety for older adults.
items.limitation: 作为一项准实验研究，无法完全排除混杂因素，且其外部有效性可能受限于特定病房环境。
items.limitationEn: As a quasi-experimental study, confounding factors cannot be fully excluded, and its external validity may be limited by the specific ward environment.

items.title: Frailty and decline in independent living in older adults: differences between the Baltic and Nordic countries
items.summary: This observational study explores differences in frailty and decline in independent living among older adults between Baltic and Nordic countries.
items.curatedReason: 不同国家（波罗的海和北欧）老年人衰弱与独立生活能力下降之间存在差异。这提示你在评估和管理老年患者衰弱时，需要考虑地理和社会文化背景，不能一概而论。
items.titleZh: 老年人衰弱与独立生活能力下降：波罗的海和北欧国家的差异
items.summaryZh: 这项观察性研究探讨了波罗的海和北欧国家老年人衰弱与独立生活能力下降之间的差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: Differences exist in the association between frailty and decline in independent living among older adults across Baltic and Nordic countries. This indicates that when assessing and managing frailty in older patients, you need to consider geographical and sociocultural contexts, as a one-size-fits-all approach may not apply.
items.limitation: 作为一项观察性研究，无法确定因果关系，且跨国比较可能存在数据收集和定义上的差异。
items.limitationEn: As an observational study, it cannot establish causality, and cross-country comparisons may have differences in data collection and definitions.

items.title: Biomechanical study on the interaction between the extent of lumbar vertebral lamina and facet joint removal and segmental stability: a finite element analysis
items.summary: This finite element analysis investigates the interaction between the extent of lumbar vertebral lamina and facet joint removal and segmental stability.
items.curatedReason: 腰椎椎板和关节突切除范围对节段稳定性有影响。这提示你在理解脊柱外科术式对患者生物力学影响时，必须关注手术的具体范围。这有助于你更好地为术后患者制定康复计划。
items.titleZh: 腰椎椎板和关节突切除范围与节段稳定性相互作用的生物力学研究：一项有限元分析
items.summaryZh: 这项有限元分析研究了腰椎椎板和关节突切除范围与节段稳定性之间的相互作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: The extent of lumbar vertebral lamina and facet joint removal impacts segmental stability. This indicates that when understanding the biomechanical effects of spinal surgical procedures on patients, you must pay attention to the specific scope of the surgery. This will help you better design rehabilitation plans for postoperative patients.
items.limitation: 作为有限元分析，其结果是基于计算模型而非真实人体数据，外推到临床需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: As a finite element analysis, its results are based on computational models rather than real human data, requiring caution when extrapolating to clinical practice.

items.title: Proxy indicators to support independent ageing-in-place in older people with frailty: a Delphi-style expert consultation survey
items.summary: This Delphi-style expert consultation survey identified proxy indicators to support independent ageing-in-place in older people with frailty.
items.curatedReason: 通过德尔菲专家咨询法确定的代理指标，可以支持衰弱老年人的居家独立养老。这些指标为你评估和规划居家康复服务提供了有益参考。
items.titleZh: 支持衰弱老年人居家独立养老的代理指标：一项德尔菲式专家咨询调查
items.summaryZh: 这项德尔菲式专家咨询调查确定了支持衰弱老年人居家独立养老的代理指标。
items.curatedReasonEn: Proxy indicators identified through a Delphi expert consultation can support independent aging-in-place for older people with frailty. These indicators provide useful references for your assessment and planning of home-based rehabilitation services.
items.limitation: 德尔菲研究结果依赖于专家共识，可能受到专家构成和主观判断的影响。
items.limitationEn: Delphi study results rely on expert consensus and may be influenced by expert composition and subjective judgment.

items.title: The effect of combining visuo-vestibular exercises with manual therapy and exercise on sensorimotor function in chronic neck pain: A randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A prospective, randomized controlled trial of 58 adults with chronic neck pain found that adding visuo-vestibular exercises to manual therapy and exercise significantly improved sensorimotor function, pain, balance, and functional disability.
items.curatedReason: 将视动-前庭练习加入颈痛的手法治疗和运动可能带来额外益处，这项 RCT 提示它能改善传感器功能、疼痛和平衡。考虑在慢性颈痛患者中探索这一联合干预。
items.titleZh: 视动-前庭练习联合手法治疗和运动对慢性颈痛传感器功能的影响：一项随机对照试验。
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 58 名慢性颈痛患者的前瞻性随机对照试验发现，在标准手法治疗和运动基础上增加视动-前庭练习，可显著改善传感器功能、疼痛、平衡和功能障碍。
items.curatedReasonEn: Adding visuo-vestibular exercises to manual therapy and exercise for neck pain may offer additional benefits, with this RCT suggesting improvements in sensorimotor function, pain, and balance. Consider exploring this combined intervention in chronic neck pain patients.
items.limitation: 研究样本量为 58 名，可能需要更大规模的研究来确证效果。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a sample size of 58 participants, and larger-scale research may be needed to confirm the effects.

items.title: Evaluating the impact of high dose inpatient rehabilitation gait training on post stroke physical activity: A secondary analysis of a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A secondary analysis of an RCT investigated if higher doses of inpatient step training affect physical activity levels 12 months post-stroke and whether walking improvements during subacute rehabilitation predict 12-month physical activity.
items.curatedReason: 高剂量住院步态训练在卒中后 12 个月对体力活动水平的影响证据不一致，一项 RCT 二次分析显示出不确定性。继续关注早期康复对长期体力活动的影响。
items.titleZh: 高剂量住院康复步态训练对卒中后体力活动影响的评估：一项随机对照试验的二次分析。
items.summaryZh: 一项 RCT 的二次分析旨在评估高剂量住院步态训练是否影响卒中后 12 个月的体力活动水平，并探讨亚急性期步态改善对长期体力活动的预测作用。
items.curatedReasonEn: Evidence on the impact of high-dose inpatient gait training on physical activity at 12 months post-stroke remains inconclusive, with this secondary RCT analysis showing uncertainty. Continue focusing on early rehabilitation's influence on long-term physical activity.
items.limitation: 这是一项随机对照试验的二次分析，其原始试验设计可能并非为了评估长期体力活动作为主要终点。
items.limitationEn: This is a secondary analysis of an RCT, and the original trial design might not have been primarily powered to assess long-term physical activity as a primary outcome.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Growing Our Impact and Advancing Pediatric Physical Therapy.
items.summary: An editorial from the official publication of the APTA Section on Pediatrics discusses strategies for expanding the impact and advancing the field of pediatric physical therapy.
items.curatedReason: 这篇社论是对儿科物理治疗领域未来发展方向的呼吁。它提醒你要关注专业如何扩大影响力、推进实践和研究，以更好地服务儿童患者。
items.titleZh: 扩大影响力，推进儿科物理治疗发展
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会儿科分会官方刊物的一篇社论探讨了如何扩大儿科物理治疗的影响力并推动该领域的发展。
items.curatedReasonEn: This editorial serves as a call to action for the future direction of pediatric physical therapy. It prompts you to consider how the profession can expand its impact, advance practice, and improve research to better serve pediatric patients.
items.journal: Pediatric physical therapy : the official publication of the Section on Pediatrics of the American Physical Therapy Association

items.title: Local Coverage Determinations
items.summary: CMS outlines Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs), which define Medicare coverage for specific items and services on an intermediary or carrier-wide basis under Parts A and B.
items.curatedReason: CMS 关于地方医保覆盖决定（LCDs）的定义和流程文件明确了 Medicare B 部分覆盖服务的决策机制。你必须理解 LCDs 如何影响特定物理治疗服务的报销，因为它直接决定哪些服务能在你所在的地区获得医保支付。
items.titleZh: CMS 地方医保覆盖决定（LCDs）
items.summaryZh: 美国医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）发布了关于地方医保覆盖决定（LCDs）的政策文件，明确了 Medicare A/B 部分对特定项目和服务覆盖的决定机制。
items.curatedReasonEn: The CMS document on Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) clarifies the decision-making process for Medicare Part B covered services. You must understand how LCDs affect reimbursement for specific physical therapy services, as it directly determines which services are Medicare-payable in your region.

items.title: 国民健康“十五五”规划窗口期：基层与民营医疗机构重构发展逻辑|机构|医疗|健康|服务|基层|-健康界
items.summary: China's "15th Five-Year Plan for National Health" promotes a shift from disease-centric to health-centric care, emphasizing decentralization, strengthening grassroots healthcare, and expanding rehabilitation and elderly health services.
items.curatedReason: 中国《国民健康“十五五”规划》强调重心下沉、强基固本，并支持康复护理和老年健康服务扩容。这意味着你的执业环境将迎来重大政策机遇，应主动关注基层医疗和老年康复服务的需求增长，调整战略定位。
items.titleZh: 国民健康“十五五”规划窗口期：基层与民营医疗机构重构发展逻辑
items.summaryZh: 中国《国民健康“十五五”规划》提出，医疗卫生行业将转向以人民健康为中心，资源下沉基层，并扩容康复护理和老年健康服务，预示着基层和民营医疗机构面临转型机遇。
items.curatedReasonEn: China's "15th Five-Year Plan for National Health" emphasizes decentralization and strengthening grassroots healthcare, while expanding rehabilitation and elderly care services. This signals significant policy opportunities for your practice; proactively monitor the growing demand for grassroots medical and elderly rehabilitation services and adjust your strategic positioning.

items.title: Machine learning-based prediction of individualized musculoskeletal responses during shoulder exercises using surface electromyography: a cross-sectional, repeated-measures laboratory study
items.summary: A cross-sectional laboratory study explored machine learning's ability to predict individualized musculoskeletal responses during shoulder exercises using surface electromyography.
items.curatedReason: 这项探索性研究提示，机器学习在根据表面肌电图预测肩部运动反应方面有潜力，未来可能支持个性化的康复方案。目前仍是早期技术，离临床应用还有距离。
items.titleZh: 基于机器学习的表面肌电图预测肩部运动个体化肌肉骨骼反应
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面、重复测量实验室研究，探讨了基于机器学习利用表面肌电图预测肩部运动期间个体化肌肉骨骼反应的潜力，为运动科学和康复提供了新的视角。
items.curatedReasonEn: This exploratory study suggests the potential of machine learning to predict individualized musculoskeletal responses during shoulder exercises using surface EMG, which could support personalized rehabilitation. This remains an early technology, some distance from clinical application.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面、重复测量实验室研究，样本量和外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional, repeated-measures laboratory study with limited sample size and generalizability.

items.title: Carbon fiber traction table use is associated with a lower incidence of stress shielding and cortical hypertrophy after total hip arthroplasty: a case-control study
items.summary: A case-control study found that the use of carbon fiber traction tables during total hip arthroplasty was associated with a lower incidence of stress shielding and cortical hypertrophy.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提示，在全髋关节置换术中使用碳纤维牵引床可能与术后应力遮挡和皮质肥厚发生率降低相关。虽然是观察性研究，但为术中设备选择提供了初步参考。
items.titleZh: 碳纤维牵引床在全髋关节置换术中与应力遮挡和皮质肥厚发生率降低相关
items.summaryZh: 一项病例对照研究发现，在全髋关节置换术中使用碳纤维牵引床与术后应力遮挡和皮质肥厚发生率降低相关。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study suggests that using a carbon fiber traction table during total hip arthroplasty may be associated with a lower incidence of postoperative stress shielding and cortical hypertrophy. Although an observational study, it offers preliminary insights for intraoperative equipment selection.
items.limitation: 病例对照研究的设计限制了其建立因果关系的能力，结果可能受混杂因素影响。
items.limitationEn: The case-control study design limits its ability to establish causality, and results may be affected by confounding factors.

items.title: The prevention of heterotopic ossification around the knee: a scoping review
items.summary: This scoping review explores current strategies for the prevention of heterotopic ossification around the knee.
items.curatedReason: 当前膝关节周围异位骨化的预防策略仍缺乏统一指南。这篇范围综述梳理了现有文献，提示我们可以参考的方案，但也明确了哪些领域尚无成熟证据，避免盲目干预。
items.titleZh: 膝关节周围异位骨化预防的范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一篇范围综述探讨了膝关节周围异位骨化的现有预防策略，总结了相关文献，旨在识别研究空白并为未来研究提供方向。
items.curatedReasonEn: Current strategies for preventing heterotopic ossification around the knee lack unified guidelines. This scoping review clarifies existing approaches you might consider, but also highlights areas where robust evidence is missing, guiding against unsubstantiated interventions.
items.limitation: 范围综述的性质限制了其对干预效果的量化评估。
items.limitationEn: The nature of a scoping review limits its ability to quantitatively assess intervention effectiveness.

items.title: Developmental Medicine & Child Neurology
items.summary: Developmental Medicine & Child Neurology is a journal covering a wide range of topics related to child development and neurological disorders.
items.curatedReason: 《发育医学与儿童神经病学》是儿科神经康复领域的权威期刊。为了跟上该领域的最新进展，你应该定期查阅其新刊，了解发育障碍和儿童神经疾病的评估与干预前沿。
items.titleZh: 《发育医学与儿童神经病学》期刊
items.summaryZh: 《发育医学与儿童神经病学》是一本涵盖儿童发育和神经系统疾病的专业期刊，是儿科康复领域的重要资源。
items.curatedReasonEn: Developmental Medicine & Child Neurology is an authoritative journal in pediatric neurorehabilitation. To stay current, you should regularly review its new issues to keep abreast of assessment and intervention advancements for developmental disorders and pediatric neurological conditions.

items.title: External Validation of a Machine Learning Model for the Early Prediction of Upper-Limb Recovery After Stroke.
items.summary: External validation of a machine learning model for predicting 6-month upper-limb capacity after stroke showed good performance in an independent Danish cohort. Predictions were generated from baseline assessments at 2 weeks post-stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究对卒中后上肢恢复的机器学习预测模型进行了外部验证，结果显示，该模型在不同队列中仍能保持良好的预测性能。这意味着，在卒中早期结合机器学习工具，有助于你更可靠地规划康复方案。
items.titleZh: 早期预测卒中后上肢恢复的机器学习模型的外部验证
items.summaryZh: 一项针对卒中后上肢恢复机器学习预测模型的外部验证显示，该模型在独立的丹麦队列中仍能良好预测卒中后 6 个月上肢能力，预测基于卒中后 2 周的基线评估。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study externally validated a machine learning model for predicting upper-limb recovery after stroke, demonstrating good predictive performance across different cohorts. This suggests that integrating machine learning tools early post-stroke can help you plan rehabilitation more reliably.
items.limitation: 研究使用的模型是基于特定队列开发的，模型在其他更广泛或异质性更强的患者群体中的表现仍需进一步验证。
items.limitationEn: The model was developed on specific cohorts; its performance in broader or more heterogeneous patient populations still requires further validation.

items.title: Acute Effects of Varying Neuromuscular Electrical Stimulation Amplitude on Quadriceps Isometric Torque and Muscle Thickness in Healthy Young Adults: A Randomized Split-Limb Trial.
items.summary: A randomized split-limb trial on healthy young adults found varying neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) amplitude affects quadriceps isometric torque and muscle thickness. Higher amplitudes enhanced acute neuromuscular responses.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机肢体交叉试验提示，NMES 刺激幅度与股四头肌等长扭矩和肌肉厚度之间存在剂量反应关系。在健康人群中，高刺激强度可以带来更强的急性神经肌肉反应，但注意这只是急性效应，且人群是健康年轻人。
items.titleZh: 不同神经肌肉电刺激幅度对健康年轻人股四头肌等长扭矩和肌肉厚度的急性影响：一项随机肢体交叉试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对健康年轻人的随机肢体交叉试验表明，调整神经肌肉电刺激（NMES）幅度会影响股四头肌等长扭矩和肌肉厚度，高刺激强度可增强急性神经肌肉反应。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized split-limb trial suggests a dose-response relationship between NMES amplitude and quadriceps isometric torque/muscle thickness. Higher stimulation intensity can lead to stronger acute neuromuscular responses in healthy young adults, but note this is an acute effect and in a healthy population.
items.limitation: 研究仅评估了健康年轻人的急性反应，结果外推到临床患者群体及长期效果需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study only assessed acute responses in healthy young adults; caution is needed when generalizing these findings to clinical patient populations and long-term effects.
items.journal: Physiotherapy research international : the journal for researchers and clinicians in physical therapy

items.title: Effect of Combined Aerobic and Resistance Training on Exercise Capacity, Muscle Strength, Quality of Life, and Mortality in Patients with Coronary Heart Disease: A Systematic Review with Meta-analysis
items.summary: A systematic review with meta-analysis found that combined aerobic and resistance training improves exercise capacity, muscle strength, quality of life, and mortality in patients with coronary heart disease.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述和 Meta 分析强化了联合有氧和阻力训练对冠心病患者运动能力、肌肉力量、生活质量和死亡率的益处。继续将这两种训练模式作为心肺康复的核心。
items.titleZh: 联合有氧和阻力训练对冠心病患者运动能力、肌肉力量、生活质量和死亡率的影响：一项系统综述与 Meta 分析
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述与 Meta 分析发现，联合有氧和阻力训练能改善冠心病患者的运动能力、肌肉力量、生活质量和死亡率。
items.curatedReasonEn: This high-quality systematic review and meta-analysis confirms that combined aerobic and resistance training significantly improves exercise capacity, muscle strength, quality of life, and reduces mortality in coronary heart disease patients. It's wise to make these two training modalities core interventions in cardiopulmonary rehabilitation.
items.limitation: 虽然是系统综述，但其结果的异质性可能受纳入研究质量和干预方案差异的影响。
items.limitationEn: Despite being a systematic review, result heterogeneity might be influenced by the quality of included studies and variations in intervention protocols.

items.title: Proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule: What PTs Need to Know, Part 2
items.summary: CMS's proposed 2027 Medicare Physician Fee Schedule includes changes to the Quality Payment Program, potentially ending the Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS) in 2029.
items.curatedReason: 美国 CMS 提议在 2029 年结束 MIPS，并改变 Medicare 医生收费标准中的实践费用计算方法。如果你是美国 PT，需密切关注这些变化，因为它们可能影响你的报销金额和质量报告要求。
items.titleZh: 拟议的 2027 年 Medicare 医生收费标准：PTs 需要了解的，第二部分
items.summaryZh: CMS 拟议的 2027 年 Medicare 医生收费标准包括质量支付计划的调整，可能在 2029 年结束“基于绩效的激励支付系统（MIPS）”。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS in the US proposes ending MIPS in 2029 and changing how practice expenses are calculated in the Medicare Physician Fee Schedule. If you are a US PT, monitor these changes closely as they may affect your reimbursement and quality reporting requirements.

items.title: Reduced ipsilateral pre-operative forefoot pressure during gait is associated with poorer post-operative postural control in people with chronic ankle instability
items.summary: A cross-sectional study found that reduced ipsilateral pre-operative forefoot pressure during gait is associated with poorer post-operative postural control in individuals with chronic ankle instability.
items.curatedReason: 对于慢性踝关节不稳患者，术前步态中内侧前足压力降低可能预示术后平衡控制能力较差。这提示我们在术前评估时要关注足底压力分布，并可能需要针对性地加强术后平衡训练。
items.titleZh: 慢性踝关节不稳患者术前步态中同侧前足压力降低与术后姿势控制能力下降相关
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究发现，慢性踝关节不稳患者术前步态中同侧前足压力降低与术后姿势控制能力下降相关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: In individuals with chronic ankle instability, reduced ipsilateral pre-operative forefoot pressure during gait may predict poorer post-operative postural control. This suggests focusing on plantar pressure distribution during pre-operative assessment and potentially intensifying post-operative balance training.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法确立因果关系，其发现可能仅为关联性而非预后性。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which cannot establish causality; its findings may indicate association rather than prognosis.

items.title: Association between stride length variability and osteosarcopenia in community-dwelling older women: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: A cross-sectional study found an association between stride length variability and osteosarcopenia in community-dwelling older women.
items.curatedReason: 在社区居住的老年女性中，步长变异性与骨质疏松性肌少症存在关联。这提示我们，评估老年女性跌倒和骨折风险时，步态稳定性（如步长变异性）可能是一个与肌少症和骨密度同样重要的指标。
items.titleZh: 社区居住老年女性步长变异性与骨质疏松性肌少症的关联：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项横断面研究发现，社区居住老年女性的步长变异性与骨质疏松性肌少症之间存在关联。
items.curatedReasonEn: In community-dwelling older women, stride length variability is associated with osteosarcopenia. This suggests that when assessing fall and fracture risk in older women, gait stability (e.g., stride length variability) might be as important an indicator as sarcopenia and bone density.
items.limitation: 这是一项横断面研究，无法确定步长变异性与骨质疏松性肌少症之间的因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is a cross-sectional study, which cannot determine the causal relationship between stride length variability and osteosarcopenia.

items.title: Instrumented assessment of joint neuromechanics in upper motor neuron syndrome: a systematic review of methods, reliability, validity, and clinical relevance
items.summary: A systematic review explored the instrumented assessment of joint neuromechanics in upper motor neuron syndrome, focusing on methods, reliability, validity, and clinical relevance.
items.curatedReason: 这项系统综述为上运动神经元综合征患者关节神经力学的器械评估提供了方法学、可靠性、有效性和临床相关性的概述。它能帮助你更好地理解和选择评估神经系统损伤后关节力学的工具，但没有直接的干预建议。
items.titleZh: 上运动神经元综合征关节神经力学器械评估：方法、可靠性、有效性和临床相关性系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项系统综述探讨了上运动神经元综合征中关节神经力学器械评估的方法、可靠性、有效性和临床相关性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This systematic review provides an overview of methods, reliability, validity, and clinical relevance for instrumented assessment of joint neuromechanics in upper motor neuron syndrome. It can help you better understand and select tools for evaluating joint mechanics after neurological injury, but offers no direct intervention recommendations.
items.limitation: 该综述侧重于评估方法本身，而非特定干预措施的疗效。
items.limitationEn: This review focuses on assessment methods themselves, rather than the efficacy of specific interventions.

items.title: How PT-PTA Teams Are Expanding Access to Care
items.summary: Physical therapists and physical therapist assistants are enhancing collaboration to improve access, efficiency, and patient outcomes in various care settings.
items.curatedReason: PT-PTA 团队的有效协作是扩大护理可及性、提高效率和改善患者结局的关键。重新审视并优化你所在机构的 PT-PTA 协作模式，是确保高质量服务的重要一步。
items.titleZh: PT-PTA 团队如何扩大护理可及性
items.summaryZh: 物理治疗师和物理治疗师助理正在加强协作，以改善各种护理环境下的服务可及性、效率和患者结局。
items.curatedReasonEn: Effective PT-PTA team collaboration is crucial for expanding care access, improving efficiency, and enhancing patient outcomes. Re-evaluating and optimizing your facility's PT-PTA collaboration model is an important step towards ensuring high-quality services.

items.title: Telerehabilitation before and after lumbar spine surgery: A scoping review.
items.summary: A scoping review mapped existing evidence on telerehabilitation interventions for patients undergoing lumbar spine surgery, finding a lack of standardized protocols, despite established effectiveness in general low back pain and joint replacement.
items.curatedReason: 对于腰椎术前术后康复，远程医疗的证据基础尚不成熟。尽管既往在 LBP 和关节置换领域有效，但该综述指出，腰椎术后远程康复的干预措施、方案和技术仍缺乏标准化。
items.titleZh: 腰椎手术前后的远程康复：一项范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述梳理了腰椎手术患者的远程康复干预现有证据，发现尽管在腰痛和关节置换中远程康复已显示出疗效，但腰椎术后缺乏标准化方案。
items.curatedReasonEn: The evidence base for telerehabilitation in pre- and post-lumbar spine surgery is still nascent. While effective for LBP and joint replacement, this review highlights a lack of standardized interventions, protocols, and technologies for post-lumbar spine surgery telerehabilitation.
items.limitation: 这是一项范围综述，侧重于映射现有证据而非评估证据质量，因此无法就干预效果给出强有力的结论。
items.limitationEn: This is a scoping review focused on mapping existing evidence rather than assessing its quality, thus strong conclusions on intervention efficacy cannot be drawn.
items.journal: PM & R : the journal of injury, function, and rehabilitation

items.title: Preliminary effects of myofascial release on chest mobility and trunk impairmentin patients with chronic stroke: a pilotRandomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A pilot RCT with 20 chronic stroke patients found that myofascial release combined with inspiratory muscle training might improve chest mobility and trunk impairment compared to stretching and diaphragmatic breathing.
items.curatedReason: 这是一项小样本先导研究，提示筋膜松动术结合吸气肌训练可能改善慢性卒中患者的胸廓活动度。结果有趣但非定论，别急着作为常规方案，可考虑作为观察性辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 筋膜松动术对慢性卒中患者胸廓活动度和躯干功能障碍的初步影响：一项先导随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 20 名慢性卒中患者的先导随机对照试验发现，筋膜松动术结合吸气肌训练可能改善患者的胸廓活动度和躯干功能障碍，优于拉伸和膈肌呼吸。
items.curatedReasonEn: This pilot study suggests myofascial release combined with inspiratory muscle training might improve chest mobility in chronic stroke patients. The findings are interesting but not definitive. Do not rush to integrate this as a standard protocol; consider it an observational adjunct.
items.limitation: 这是一项样本量极小的先导研究 (n=20)，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This is a very small pilot study (n=20), limiting the generalizability of its findings.

items.title: Outcomes of rehabilitation following device-aided therapy start in parkinson's disease: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial (N=45) found that adding tailored primary care rehabilitation to device-aided therapy in Parkinson's disease resulted in better maintenance of patient motor skills at 6 and 12 months compared to device-aided therapy alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 为帕金森病患者在设备辅助治疗启动后加用量身定制的基层康复提供了坚实的证据，它能更好地维持患者的运动技能。这意味着你在为帕金森患者制定康复计划时，应积极考虑在早期将个性化康复干预与设备辅助治疗相结合。
items.titleZh: 帕金森病患者设备辅助治疗启动后康复结局：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验（N=45）发现，在帕金森病设备辅助治疗基础上增加量身定制的基层康复，能更好地维持患者在 6 个月和 12 个月时的运动技能，优于仅设备辅助治疗。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT provides robust evidence that tailored primary care rehabilitation, when added after device-aided therapy initiation in Parkinson's disease, better maintains patient motor skills. This means you should actively consider integrating personalized rehabilitation interventions with device-aided therapy early when planning rehabilitation for Parkinson's patients.
items.limitation: 样本量相对较小（45/54 名患者完成），可能限制结果的普适性。
items.limitationEn: The relatively small sample size (45/54 patients completed) may limit the generalizability of the results.

items.title: Pregnancy-Related Musculoskeletal Pain: Current Management, Influence on Biopsychosocial Health, and Patient-Reported Satisfaction With Care.
items.summary: An international internet survey of 671 women found that while musculoskeletal pain is common during pregnancy, less than 1 in 5 respondents reported being referred to physical therapy, highlighting a gap in care.
items.curatedReason: 这次国际调查显示，尽管孕期肌肉骨骼疼痛很常见，但转诊到物理治疗的比例仍然很低，只有不到 1/5 的患者获得了转诊。这提示你在诊所中应更积极地筛查孕期 MSK 疼痛，并主动推广物理治疗的价值。
items.titleZh: 孕期肌肉骨骼疼痛：现有管理、对生物心理社会健康的影响以及患者对护理的满意度
items.summaryZh: 一项对 671 名女性进行的国际在线调查显示，孕期肌肉骨骼疼痛很常见，但只有不到 1/5 的受访者表示曾被转诊至物理治疗，这突显了护理方面的缺口。
items.curatedReasonEn: This international survey indicates that despite the high prevalence of pregnancy-related musculoskeletal pain, physical therapy referral rates remain low, with less than one-fifth of patients receiving referrals. This suggests you should more proactively screen for MSK pain during pregnancy and actively promote the value of physical therapy.
items.limitation: 研究采用互联网调查设计，可能存在选择偏倚和回忆偏倚，且无法评估因果关系。
items.limitationEn: The study utilized an internet survey design, which may introduce selection and recall bias, and causality cannot be assessed.

items.title: Accelerated Return to Competition Following a Full-Thickness Abdominal Wall Tear in an Elite Sprinter: A Data-informed Case Report.
items.summary: This case report describes the rehabilitation and accelerated return to competition for a 22-year-old elite sprinter who sustained a full-thickness lateral abdominal wall tear, emphasizing data-informed decision-making.
items.curatedReason: 对于罕见的腹壁全层撕裂，这份单病例报告提示，即便是精英运动员，通过严密监控数据也能实现加速康复和重返赛场。在处理类似损伤时，请务必关注具体的功能指标和表现数据，不要被动等待。
items.titleZh: 精英短跑运动员腹壁全层撕裂后加速重返赛场：一项数据驱动的病例报告
items.summaryZh: 本病例报告描述了一名 22 岁精英短跑运动员腹壁外侧全层撕裂后的康复和加速重返赛场过程，强调了数据驱动的决策。
items.curatedReasonEn: For rare full-thickness abdominal wall tears, this single case suggests that even elite athletes can achieve accelerated rehab and return to sport with rigorous data-informed monitoring. When managing similar injuries, focus on specific functional metrics and performance data; do not passively wait.
items.limitation: 作为单病例报告，其发现的普适性非常有限，不能直接推断到其他患者。
items.limitationEn: As a single case report, the generalizability of its findings is very limited and cannot be directly extrapolated to other patients.
items.journal: International journal of sports physical therapy

items.title: Updated Clinical Practice Guideline for Physical Therapist Management After TKA
items.summary: The American Physical Therapy Association (APTA) has published an updated clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management after total knee arthroplasty (TKA), recommending new treatments and pain management tools.
items.curatedReason: 这是 TKA 术后物理治疗管理的一项重大更新，由 APTA 发布。务必下载并研读新版指南，它将直接改变你对 TKA 患者的术后康复方案，尤其在新的治疗手段和疼痛管理工具方面。
items.titleZh: APTA 发布 TKA 术后物理治疗管理临床实践指南更新
items.summaryZh: 美国物理治疗协会 (APTA) 发布了全膝关节置换术 (TKA) 术后物理治疗管理的临床实践指南更新，推荐了新的治疗方法和疼痛管理工具。
items.curatedReasonEn: This is a significant update to the clinical practice guideline for physical therapist management after TKA, published by APTA. You must download and study the new guideline, as it will directly impact your postoperative rehabilitation protocols for TKA patients, especially regarding new treatments and pain management tools.

items.title: First trial confirms swimming reduces disability from chronic back pain
items.summary: The EduSwim clinical trial, an eight-week individualized physiotherapist-guided swimming and education program, significantly improved function and pain in individuals with chronic low back pain compared to education alone.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 首次确证了游泳对慢性腰痛患者的疗效，尤其是在功能改善方面。下次与患者讨论运动选择或跟医生沟通转诊时，你有更硬的证据支持推荐游泳。
items.titleZh: 首个试验确证游泳能减轻慢性腰痛患者的残疾程度
items.summaryZh: EduSwim 临床试验发现，为期八周、由物理治疗师指导的个性化游泳和教育方案，在改善慢性腰痛患者的功能和疼痛方面，显著优于单纯教育。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT is the first to confirm the clinical effectiveness of swimming for chronic low back pain, particularly in improving function. You now have stronger evidence to support recommending swimming when discussing exercise options with patients or referring them to physicians.
items.limitation: 研究未详细说明患者的入组标准和具体疼痛时长，可能影响结果的外推性。
items.limitationEn: The study did not detail patient inclusion criteria or specific pain duration, which may affect the generalizability of the results.

items.title: American Physical Therapy Association: APTA Regulatory, Legislative, and Payment Updates Series (2026)
items.summary: APTA's Health Policy and Payment team will provide an overview of the most significant federal regulatory and commercial payer policy updates for 2026, offering critical insights for physical therapists.
items.curatedReason: APTA 每年都会提供联邦和商业付款方政策的重要更新系列课程。你作为 PT/PTA 成员免费，务必参加这些课程，以确保你的执业和报销符合最新的联邦和商业保险规定。
items.titleZh: 美国物理治疗协会：APTA 监管、立法和支付更新系列 (2026)
items.summaryZh: APTA 的健康政策和支付团队将概述 2026 年最重要的联邦监管和商业支付方政策更新，为物理治疗师提供关键见解。
items.curatedReasonEn: APTA annually offers a crucial series of updates on federal and commercial payer policies. As a PT/PTA member, these courses are free and essential to ensure your practice and reimbursement comply with the latest federal and commercial insurance regulations.

items.title: Proposed '27 Home Health Rule: 2.4% Increase Likely Reduced by PDGM Adjustments
items.summary: CMS's proposed 2027 Home Health Rule estimates a 2.4% payment increase, but temporary PDGM adjustments are likely to result in lower total payments for home health agencies, with comments due by August 31, 2026.
items.curatedReason: CMS 提出了 2027 年居家医疗规则，预计总支付额因 PDGM 调整而减少。你必须关注此提案，因为它直接影响居家物理治疗服务的报销和营运，有必要在 8 月 31 日前提交意见。
items.titleZh: 拟议的 2027 年居家医疗规则：2.4% 的增长可能因 PDGM 调整而减少
items.summaryZh: CMS 提出的 2027 年居家医疗规则预计支付将增加 2.4%，但临时 PDGM 调整可能导致居家医疗机构的实际总支付低于预期，意见征集截止日期为 2026 年 8 月 31 日。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has proposed the 2027 Home Health Rule, with total payments likely reduced due to PDGM adjustments. You must pay attention to this proposal, as it directly impacts reimbursement and operations for home physical therapy services. It is essential to submit comments before August 31.

items.title: Inpatient Rehabilitation Facility PPS
items.summary: CMS issued the FY 2027 Inpatient Rehabilitation Facility Prospective Payment System proposed rule, proposing updates to Medicare payment policies and rates, with comments due by June 1.
items.curatedReason: CMS 发布了 2027 财年住院康复机构前瞻性支付系统（IRF PPS）拟议规则。你必须在 6 月 1 日前提交意见，以确保物理治疗师在住院康复中的利益得到代表，并了解支付政策的潜在变化。
items.titleZh: 住院康复机构前瞻性支付系统（IRF PPS）2027 财年拟议规则
items.summaryZh: CMS 发布了 2027 财年住院康复机构前瞻性支付系统拟议规则，提出了对 Medicare 支付政策和费率的更新，意见征集截止日期为 6 月 1 日。
items.curatedReasonEn: CMS has released the proposed rule for the Fiscal Year 2027 Inpatient Rehabilitation Facility Prospective Payment System (IRF PPS). You must submit comments by June 1 to ensure the interests of physical therapists in inpatient rehabilitation are represented and to understand potential changes in payment policies.

items.title: Biopsychosocial predictors of functional recovery in chronic low back pain following physiotherapy: A survival analysis study.
items.summary: A prospective observational cohort study with 250 adults with chronic nonspecific low back pain found that lower baseline Oswestry Disability Index (ODI) scores, less pain catastrophizing, and higher pain self-efficacy predicted faster functional recovery following individualized physiotherapy.
items.curatedReason: 这项前瞻性观察研究揭示了生物心理社会因素对慢性腰痛患者接受物理治疗后功能恢复时长的影响。研究强调了基线时ODI评分越低、疼痛灾难化程度越低、疼痛自我效能感越高，恢复速度越快，这支持了在评估和治疗方案设计中整合这些因素的重要性。
items.titleZh: 生物心理社会因素对物理治疗后慢性腰痛功能恢复的预测作用：一项生存分析研究
items.summaryZh: 一项对250名慢性非特异性腰痛成人进行的前瞻性观察队列研究发现，较低的基线Oswestry残疾指数（ODI）评分、较低的疼痛灾难化水平和较高的疼痛自我效能感预示着个体化物理治疗后更快速的功能恢复。
items.curatedReasonEn: This prospective observational study reveals the influence of biopsychosocial factors on the timing of functional recovery in chronic low back pain patients undergoing physiotherapy. It highlights that lower baseline ODI scores, less pain catastrophizing, and higher pain self-efficacy are associated with faster recovery, underscoring the importance of integrating these factors into assessment and treatment planning.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性队列研究，仅能揭示相关性，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: As an observational cohort study, this research can only suggest associations and cannot establish causality.

items.title: Measurements and management of multiple sclerosis-related fatigue: an umbrella review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: An umbrella review and meta-analysis of 46 systematic reviews found that exercise provides the most consistent benefit for MS-related fatigue, with aerobic training showing a modest but reliable reduction (SMD -0.32).
items.curatedReason: 这份伞形综述和荟萃分析强力支持运动疗法作为多发性硬化症（MS）相关疲劳的一线干预。你可以将有氧训练和阻力训练明确纳入 MS 患者的疲劳管理方案中。
items.titleZh: 多发性硬化症相关疲劳的测量与管理：一项伞形综述和荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 一项涵盖 46 篇系统综述的伞形综述和荟萃分析发现，运动疗法对多发性硬化症（MS）相关疲劳的益处最一致，其中有氧训练能适度但可靠地减轻疲劳（SMD -0.32）。
items.curatedReasonEn: This umbrella review and meta-analysis strongly supports exercise therapy as a first-line intervention for multiple sclerosis (MS)-related fatigue. You can confidently integrate aerobic and resistance training into your fatigue management protocols for MS patients.
items.limitation: 该研究关注的结局指标仅限于疲劳，未报告对其他MS相关症状或生活质量的影响。
items.limitationEn: The study focused exclusively on fatigue as an outcome, not reporting effects on other MS-related symptoms or quality of life.

items.title: What percentage of severely impaired stroke survivors retain residual voluntary EMG?
items.summary: A study with 100 severely impaired stroke survivors investigated the feasibility of detecting residual electromyography (EMG) activity in wrist extensors to identify movement intention in patients without visible movement.
items.curatedReason: 对于严重卒中后无自主腕伸的患者，很高比例能检测到残余肌电信号。这意味着肌电信号可能作为脑机接口的实用替代方案，为这些患者提供机器人辅助，拓宽康复干预的窗口。
items.titleZh: 严重受损卒中幸存者保留残余自主肌电图的比例是多少？
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 100 名无主动腕伸的严重受损卒中幸存者的研究，旨在探讨能否通过高密度表面肌电图（EMG）检测腕伸肌中的残余肌电活动，以评估其作为运动意图检测手段的可行性。
items.curatedReasonEn: A high percentage of severely impaired stroke patients without voluntary wrist extension still show residual EMG activity. This suggests EMG could be a practical alternative for brain-computer interfaces, enabling robotic assistance and broadening rehabilitation options for these patients.
items.limitation: 这是一项探索性研究，旨在评估肌电信号的检测可行性，而非干预效果评估，因此不涉及临床结局。
items.limitationEn: This is an exploratory study assessing EMG signal detectability, not an intervention effectiveness trial, and therefore does not involve clinical outcomes.

items.title: The effect of online physical activity monitoring on physical activity level, psychological health, fatigue, and quality of life in patients with multiple sclerosis: a randomized controlled trial.
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial with 42 MS patients found that continuous online monitoring of walking activity with messaging reminders improved psychological health and fatigue, but had no significant effect on physical activity levels or quality of life.
items.curatedReason: 在线活动监测结合提醒能轻度改善 MS 患者的心理健康和疲劳，但对身体活动量和生活质量的改善不显著。将其作为现有干预的辅助手段，别指望它单枪匹马提升活动量。
items.titleZh: 在线身体活动监测对多发性硬化症患者身体活动水平、心理健康、疲劳和生活质量的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 42 名多发性硬化症（MS）患者的随机对照试验显示，通过消息应用进行步行为主的身体活动持续监测和提醒，能改善患者的心理健康和疲劳，但对身体活动水平和生活质量没有显著影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: Online activity monitoring with reminders showed mild improvements in psychological health and fatigue for MS patients, but no significant gains in physical activity levels or quality of life. Use it as an adjunct, not a standalone solution for activity increase.
items.limitation: 研究样本量较小（42 人），随访时间及干预的具体强度未详细阐述，且仅关注了计步器为主的步行活动。
items.limitationEn: The study has a small sample size (42 participants), and details regarding follow-up duration and intervention intensity are not fully elaborated, focusing primarily on step-based walking activity.

items.title: AI Scribes in Physical Therapy Practices
items.summary: An APTA article explores the use of AI-enabled ambient scribe technology in physical therapy practices, discussing what PTs and PTAs need to know for implementation.
items.curatedReason: APTA 这篇报告探讨了 AI 秘书在物理治疗实践中的应用。随着技术发展，了解 AI 如何辅助文档、改善工作流程、以及潜在的合规和伦理问题，对你未来的执业至关重要。你需要评估它能否在你的实践中提高效率。
items.titleZh: 物理治疗实践中的 AI 秘书
items.summaryZh: APTA 的一篇文章探讨了 AI 驱动的环境智能秘书技术在物理治疗实践中的应用，讨论了物理治疗师和物理治疗师助理在实施该技术时需要了解的事项。
items.curatedReasonEn: This APTA report discusses the application of AI scribes in physical therapy practices. As technology advances, understanding how AI can assist with documentation, improve workflow, and address potential compliance and ethical issues is crucial for your future practice. You need to evaluate whether it can enhance efficiency in your practice.

items.title: How many repeated observations are enough for digital gait summaries? A multi-dataset framework for sampling sufficiency in older adults
items.summary: A study in the Journal of NeuroEngineering and Rehabilitation presents a multi-dataset framework to determine the sufficient number of repeated observations for digital gait summaries in older adults.
items.curatedReason: 在老年人数字步态评估中，你需要多少重复观察才能获得可靠数据？这项观察研究提供了一个多数据集框架来帮你确定，有助于你优化采样策略，避免过度或不足采样。
items.titleZh: 老年人数字步态摘要需要多少次重复观察？一个多数据集采样充分性框架
items.summaryZh: 《神经工程与康复杂志》的一项研究提出了一个多数据集框架，用于确定老年人数字步态摘要所需的重复观察次数。
items.curatedReasonEn: How many repeated observations do you need for reliable data in digital gait assessment in older adults? This observational study provides a multi-dataset framework to help you determine this, assisting you in optimizing your sampling strategy to avoid over- or under-sampling.
items.limitation: 作为未编辑稿件，其最终内容可能仍会修改，且研究结果的外推性可能受限于所用数据集的特性。
items.limitationEn: As an unedited manuscript, its final content may still change, and the generalizability of results might be limited by the characteristics of the datasets used.

items.title: Electrically assisted bicycles in adults: a scoping review of health outcomes and relevance to rehabilitation
items.summary: A scoping review explored the health outcomes and rehabilitation relevance of electrically assisted bicycles in adults.
items.curatedReason: 电动助力自行车确实可能成为促进患者活动和心肺健康的工具，特别是对那些因体力限制难以进行传统自行车运动的人。将它纳入康复计划时，应视为一种有潜力的辅助手段。
items.titleZh: 成人电动助力自行车：健康结局与康复相关性范围综述
items.summaryZh: 一项范围综述探讨了成人电动助力自行车对健康结局及其在康复中的相关性。
items.curatedReasonEn: E-bikes could indeed be a viable tool for promoting activity and cardiopulmonary health, especially for patients with physical limitations who struggle with traditional cycling. Consider it a potential adjunct when integrating into rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 作为范围综述，其证据等级低于系统综述，更多是概括现有文献，而非提供综合性效应量。
items.limitationEn: As a scoping review, its evidence level is lower than a systematic review, primarily summarizing existing literature rather than providing comprehensive effect sizes.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Not just alignment: body shape influences adult spinal deformity biomechanics
items.summary: A study in the European Spine Journal indicates that body shape, in addition to alignment, significantly influences the biomechanics of adult spinal deformity.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究强调，除了对线，体形也会影响成人脊柱畸形的生物力学。这提示你在评估脊柱畸形患者时，需要将体形纳入考量，以便更全面地理解其生物力学负荷和功能限制。
items.titleZh: 不仅仅是力线：体形影响成人脊柱畸形生物力学
items.summaryZh: 《欧洲脊柱杂志》的一项研究表明，除了对线，体形也显著影响成人脊柱畸形的生物力学。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study emphasizes that, in addition to alignment, body shape also influences the biomechanics of adult spinal deformity. This suggests that when assessing patients with spinal deformities, you need to consider body shape to more comprehensively understand their biomechanical load and functional limitations.
items.limitation: 未明确给出研究类型和样本量，影响对证据强度的判断；生物力学研究的发现可能不直接转化为临床干预建议。
items.limitationEn: The study type and sample size are not explicitly provided, affecting the assessment of evidence strength; findings from biomechanical studies may not directly translate into clinical intervention recommendations.

items.title: The experience of cross-setting care transitions of long-term care residents to the emergency department: a qualitative study
items.summary: A qualitative study explored the experiences of cross-setting care transitions when long-term care residents are transferred to emergency departments, highlighting challenges in information and responsibility transfer.
items.curatedReason: 当长期护理居民转诊至急诊科时，信息和责任转移的挑战是真实存在的。这项定性研究提示我们，在跨机构转诊中，你需要主动沟通，确保康复服务能有效衔接，避免服务中断。
items.titleZh: 长期护理居民转诊至急诊科的跨机构护理过渡经验：一项定性研究
items.summaryZh: 一项定性研究探讨了长期护理居民转诊至急诊科时，跨机构护理过渡的经验，揭示了信息和责任转移方面的挑战。
items.curatedReasonEn: When long-term care residents are transferred to emergency departments, challenges in information and responsibility transfer are real. This qualitative study suggests that in cross-setting transitions, you need to proactively communicate to ensure effective rehabilitation service continuity and avoid service disruptions.
items.limitation: 定性研究结果的普遍性受限，主要反映特定受访者的经验。
items.limitationEn: The generalizability of qualitative study results is limited, primarily reflecting the experiences of specific interviewees.

items.title: Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation for Dizziness, Balance, and Postural Stability in Adult Patients With Chronic Peripheral Vestibular Dizziness.
items.summary: A double-blind RCT (N=56) found that repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) combined with vestibular rehabilitation (VR) significantly improved dizziness, balance, and postural stability in adults with chronic peripheral vestibular dizziness, compared to sham rTMS plus VR over 8 weeks.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 证据提示，对于慢性前庭性眩晕，经颅重复磁刺激（rTMS）结合前庭康复（VR）可能优于单纯 VR 疗法，为你的干预方案提供了新的联合治疗思路。
items.titleZh: 重复经颅磁刺激治疗慢性外周前庭性眩晕成人患者的眩晕、平衡和姿势稳定性
items.summaryZh: 一项双盲随机对照试验（N=56）发现，与安慰剂刺激加前庭康复相比，重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）结合前庭康复（VR）在 8 周内显著改善了慢性外周前庭性眩晕成人患者的眩晕、平衡和姿势稳定性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT suggests that repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) combined with vestibular rehabilitation (VR) may be superior to VR alone for chronic peripheral vestibular dizziness, offering a new combination therapy approach for your intervention strategies.
items.limitation: 研究未详细说明患者病程范围，可能存在异质性对结果的影响，同时长期随访数据有待观察。
items.limitationEn: The study did not detail the full range of patient disease duration, which might introduce heterogeneity, and long-term follow-up data are needed.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Effects of a Virtual Reality-Based Balance Training Program on Clinical Outcomes and Cortical Oscillatory Activity: A Combined Behavioral and EEG Study.
items.summary: This single-group study (N=28 subacute stroke survivors) found that 12 VR-based balance training sessions over 4 weeks improved clinical mobility outcomes and altered resting EEG activity.
items.curatedReason: VR 余额训练在亚急性卒中患者中展现了改善平衡和皮质活动的前景，但单组设计限制了结论强度，还需要进一步的 RCT 验证其优效性。
items.titleZh: 虚拟现实平衡训练对临床结果和皮质振荡活动的影响：一项行为与脑电图结合研究
items.summaryZh: 一项单组研究（28 名亚急性卒中幸存者）发现，为期 4 周的 12 次 VR 平衡训练课程改善了临床活动能力结果并改变了静息脑电图活动。
items.curatedReasonEn: VR-based balance training shows promise in improving balance and cortical activity in subacute stroke survivors. However, the single-group design limits the strength of conclusions; further RCTs are needed to confirm its efficacy.
items.limitation: 本研究为单组重复测量设计，缺乏对照组，无法排除安慰剂效应或自然恢复的影响。
items.limitationEn: This study used a single-group repeated-measures design, lacking a control group to rule out placebo effects or natural recovery.

items.title: Influence of knee hyperextension persisting into preswing on swing-phase kinematics through forward propulsion in poststroke hemiparetic gait.
items.summary: This observational study (N=30 chronic poststroke hemiparesis patients) investigated the influence of knee hyperextension persisting into preswing on swing-phase kinematics and forward propulsion.
items.curatedReason: 有卒中后偏瘫患者的步态中膝关节过伸问题？这项观察研究（N=30）提示，过伸持续到摆动前期，确实可能损害摆动期的肢体缩短，并降低向前推进力。这意味着处理膝过伸，不仅是外观问题，更是步态效率的关键。
items.titleZh: 卒中后偏瘫步态中膝关节过伸持续至摆动前期对前推进力摆动期运动学的影响
items.summaryZh: 这项观察性研究（N=30 名慢性卒中后偏瘫患者）调查了膝关节过伸持续至摆动前期对摆动期运动学和前推进力的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: For your post-stroke hemiparesis patients, persistent knee hyperextension into preswing might be more than just an aesthetic issue. This observational study (N=30) suggests it could impair swing-phase limb shortening and reduce forward propulsion, making effective intervention on hyperextension crucial for gait efficiency.
items.limitation: 作为观察性研究，本研究仅能揭示相关性，无法确立因果关系。
items.limitationEn: As an observational study, it can only identify correlations and cannot establish causality.

items.title: Quality indicators for Spanish hospital-based physical therapy units: a feasibility and inter-rater reliability study.
items.summary: This multicentre observational study in Spain evaluated the feasibility and inter-rater reliability of 22 quality indicators for hospital-based physical therapy units, finding 13 were feasible and reliable.
items.curatedReason: 西班牙医院物理治疗单位的质量指标研究，验证了 13 项指标的可行性和评估者间信度。这为你在设计单位内部质量管理和绩效评估体系时提供了参考，但注意地理和医疗系统差异。
items.titleZh: 西班牙医院物理治疗单位质量指标的的可行性与评估者间信度研究
items.summaryZh: 这项在西班牙进行的多中心观察性研究评估了医院物理治疗单位 22 项质量指标的可行性和评估者间信度，发现其中 13 项可行且可靠。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study on quality indicators for Spanish hospital PT units validated 13 indicators for feasibility and inter-rater reliability. It offers a reference for designing internal quality management and performance assessment systems, but consider geographical and healthcare system differences.
items.limitation: 本研究为描述性观察研究，仅在西班牙三家医院进行，结果外推性有限。
items.limitationEn: This descriptive observational study was conducted in only three hospitals in Spain, limiting the generalizability of the findings.

items.title: Rapid growth in autism spectrum disorder referrals reshaped rehabilitation service use: A longitudinal cohort study of children and adolescents in Brazil
items.summary: This retrospective longitudinal cohort study in Brazil analyzed how a rapid growth in autism spectrum disorder (ASD) referrals reshaped rehabilitation service use for children and adolescents between 2017-2026.
items.curatedReason: 巴西的这项队列研究揭示了自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）转诊的快速增长如何重塑康复服务需求。它提醒你注意 ASD 患者量增加对康复资源分配的潜在压力，以及在资源有限地区服务模式可能面临的挑战。
items.titleZh: 自闭症谱系障碍转诊量的快速增长重塑了康复服务的使用：一项巴西儿童和青少年纵向队列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项在巴西进行的追溯性纵向队列研究分析了 2017-2026 年间自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）转诊量的快速增长如何重塑了儿童和青少年的康复服务使用。
items.curatedReasonEn: This Brazilian cohort study reveals how the rapid growth in autism spectrum disorder (ASD) referrals is reshaping rehabilitation service demand. It highlights potential pressures on rehabilitation resource allocation due to increasing ASD patient volumes and the challenges service models may face in resource-limited regions.
items.limitation: 本研究基于单一康复中心数据，可能存在选择偏倚，且结果外推至其他国家或地区需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: This study is based on data from a single rehabilitation center, which may introduce selection bias, and generalizing the results to other countries or regions should be done with caution.

items.title: Complete Guide to Clean Claims for Rehab Therapy Billing
items.summary: This guide by WebPT provides a complete overview of the claims creation process to help rehabilitation therapy clinics achieve clean claims and reduce denials.
items.curatedReason: 这份指南提供了物理治疗索赔清算流程的全面指导，能够显著提高你的诊所营收。通过优化索赔提交，你能减少拒付并确保收入稳定。
items.titleZh: 康复治疗账单“洁净索赔”完整指南
items.summaryZh: WebPT 发布了一份关于康复治疗账单“洁净索赔”的完整指南，旨在帮助诊所优化索赔创建流程，提高首次通过率，从而确保收入稳定并减少拒付。
items.curatedReasonEn: This guide provides comprehensive instructions for streamlining physical therapy claims, which can significantly boost your clinic's revenue. By optimizing claim submissions, you can reduce denials and ensure stable income.

items.title: Epidemiological burden and associated factors of shoulder problems in indoor competitive volleyball players: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review on shoulder problems in indoor competitive volleyball players, published in BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation, details the epidemiological burden and associated factors of these injuries.
items.curatedReason: 排球运动员肩部问题的流行病学数据是你在评估和管理这类损伤时的重要参考。了解相关危险因素，能帮助你更好地进行预防和早期干预。
items.titleZh: 室内竞技排球运动员肩部问题的流行病学负担及相关因素：系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项发表在《BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation》的系统综述，详细阐述了室内竞技排球运动员肩部问题的流行病学负担及相关因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: The high incidence and associated risk factors for shoulder problems in volleyball players are crucial for your assessment and management of these injuries. Using this epidemiological data will help you more effectively prevent and intervene early.
items.limitation: 系统综述存在纳入研究异质性高的普遍局限，可能影响流行病学数据的精确性。
items.limitationEn: Systematic reviews commonly have limitations due to high heterogeneity among included studies, which may affect the precision of epidemiological data.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: What is the impact of CRP, hs-CRP, IL-6, IL-10, and TNFα in physical performance in community-dwelling older adults: a systematic review
items.summary: A systematic review published in BMC Geriatrics investigated the impact of inflammatory biomarkers (CRP, hs-CRP, IL-6, IL-10, and TNFα) on physical performance in community-dwelling older adults.
items.curatedReason: 炎症生物标志物与社区老年人身体表现之间的关联，是你在评估老年患者衰弱风险时应考虑的重要因素。结合这些指标，你能更全面地进行风险评估和干预计划。
items.titleZh: CRP、hs-CRP、IL-6、IL-10 和 TNFα 对社区老年人身体表现的影响：一项系统综述
items.summaryZh: 一项发表在《BMC Geriatrics》的系统综述，探讨了 CRP、hs-CRP、IL-6、IL-10 和 TNFα 等炎症生物标志物对社区老年人身体表现的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: The association between inflammatory biomarkers and physical performance in community-dwelling older adults is a crucial factor to consider when assessing frailty risk in elderly patients. Integrating these indicators allows for a more comprehensive risk assessment and intervention planning.
items.limitation: 作为系统综述，其结论受限于纳入研究的异质性与质量。
items.limitationEn: As a systematic review, its conclusions are limited by the heterogeneity and quality of the included studies.

items.title: Region-specific hamstring activation and its dissociation from subjective contraction sensation during leg curl exercise at different hip flexion angles
items.summary: A study in BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation investigated region-specific hamstring activation and its dissociation from subjective contraction sensation during leg curl exercise at different hip flexion angles.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究提供了踇绳肌在不同髋关节屈曲角度下区域激活的实证数据。在设计针对性踇绳肌训练时，你应考虑这些区域激活差异，以优化训练效果。
items.titleZh: 不同髋关节屈曲角度下腘绳肌区域激活及其与主观收缩感知的差异
items.summaryZh: 《BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation》上的一项研究探讨了在不同髋关节屈曲角度下，腿弯举运动中腘绳肌的区域激活及其与主观收缩感知之间的差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study provides empirical data on region-specific hamstring activation at different hip flexion angles. When designing targeted hamstring training, you should consider these regional activation differences to optimize training effectiveness.
items.limitation: 研究观察的是急性效应而非长期训练适应性，结果外推到训练方案设计需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study observed acute effects rather than long-term training adaptations, so results should be cautiously extrapolated to exercise program design.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Sex- and age-specific risk factors for possible sarcopenic obesity in community-dwelling older adults: a cross-sectional study
items.summary: A cross-sectional study in BMC Geriatrics identified sex- and age-specific risk factors for possible sarcopenic obesity in community-dwelling older adults.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究指出了社区老年人肌少性肥胖在性别和年龄上的特异性危险因素。你在评估老年患者时，应根据这些因素进行更精细的风险分层，以实现早期识别和干预。
items.titleZh: 社区老年人潜在肌少性肥胖的性别和年龄特异性危险因素：一项横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 一项发表在《BMC Geriatrics》的横断面研究，揭示了社区老年人潜在肌少性肥胖的性别和年龄特异性危险因素。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study identifies sex- and age-specific risk factors for sarcopenic obesity in community-dwelling older adults. When assessing elderly patients, you should use these factors for more precise risk stratification, enabling earlier identification and intervention.
items.limitation: 作为一项横断面研究，无法建立因果关系，仅能提示相关性。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional study, it cannot establish causality, only suggest associations.

items.title: Gait adaptations and spinal curvature correlations following lumbar arthrodesis: an analytic cross-sectional study
items.summary: A cross-sectional study in BMC Musculoskeletal Disorders investigated gait adaptations and spinal curvature correlations following lumbar arthrodesis.
items.curatedReason: 这项研究揭示了腰椎关节融合术后步态适应和脊柱曲度之间的关联。你在评估这类术后患者时，应综合考虑步态模式和脊柱生物力学变化，以指导康复方案设计。
items.titleZh: 腰椎关节融合术后步态适应与脊柱曲度相关性：一项分析性横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 《BMC Musculoskeletal Disorders》上的一项横断面研究，探讨了腰椎关节融合术后步态适应与脊柱曲度之间的相关性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals the correlations between gait adaptations and spinal curvature following lumbar arthrodesis. When assessing such postoperative patients, you should comprehensively consider gait patterns and spinal biomechanical changes to guide rehabilitation program design.
items.limitation: 作为横断面研究，无法确定因果关系，也无法评估长期随访效果。
items.limitationEn: As a cross-sectional study, it cannot establish causality or assess long-term follow-up effects.

items.title: Additive Effects of Repetitive Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation and Transcranial Direct Current Stimulation on Robotic Therapy for Upper Extremity Recovery After Chronic Ischemic Stroke: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Sham-Controlled Trial.
items.summary: A randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial (N=36) found that adding repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) or transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) to robotic therapy did not provide additional benefits for upper extremity motor and functional recovery in patients with chronic ischemic stroke.
items.curatedReason: 这项RCT明确指出，在慢性缺血性卒中患者上肢恢复中，重复经颅磁刺激 (rTMS) 或经颅直流电刺激 (tDCS) 并不能为机器人疗法带来额外益处。未来评估联用时，你需要重新审视这两种非侵入性脑刺激的定位和有效性。
items.titleZh: 重复经颅磁刺激和经颅直流电刺激对慢性缺血性卒中后上肢机器人治疗恢复的叠加效应：一项随机、双盲、假对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机、双盲、假对照试验（N=36）发现，在慢性缺血性卒中患者的上肢机器人治疗中，额外增加重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）或经颅直流电刺激（tDCS）并未带来额外的运动和功能恢复益处。
items.curatedReasonEn: This RCT clearly indicates that repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) or transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) does not provide additional benefits to robotic therapy for upper extremity recovery in chronic ischemic stroke patients. You need to re-evaluate the positioning and efficacy of these non-invasive brain stimulations when considering combination therapies in the future.
items.limitation: 该研究的样本量为36例，虽然是随机双盲对照，但仍属小样本，结果需更大规模研究验证。
items.limitationEn: The study involved a sample size of 36 patients; despite being a randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial, it is still a small sample, and its results require validation by larger-scale studies.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Exercise prescription: Physiotherapy's most important and least standardized skill.
items.summary: This commentary argues that exercise prescription, a ubiquitous recommendation in musculoskeletal physiotherapy, suffers from limited confidence, consistency, and clarity in its decision-making and communication, emphasizing the need for a shared language and systematic approach.
items.curatedReason: 运动处方是物理治疗的核心技能，但这项综述指出其标准化程度低、沟通不清晰，临床医师应反思自己的处方实践，考虑如何更系统地整合评估、进展和调整。
items.titleZh: 运动处方：物理治疗最重要的但也是标准化程度最低的技能
items.summaryZh: 这篇述评文章指出，运动处方作为肌肉骨骼物理治疗中的普遍推荐，在决策和沟通方面缺乏信心、一致性和清晰度，强调需要统一语言和系统方法。
items.curatedReasonEn: Exercise prescription is a core PT skill, yet this review highlights its lack of standardization and clarity in communication. Clinicians should reflect on their own prescription practices and consider how to integrate assessment, progression, and modification more systematically.
items.limitation: 这是一篇述评文章，并非系统综述或原始研究，主要基于专家意见和文献解读。
items.limitationEn: This is a commentary article, not a systematic review or original research, primarily based on expert opinion and literature interpretation.

items.title: Regulatory Alignment for Predictable and Immediate Device Coverage Pathway (CMS-3487-NC) Procedural Notice Inviting Comment
items.summary: CMS has issued a procedural notice inviting public comment on the Regulatory Alignment for Predictable and Immediate Device Coverage Pathway (CMS-3487-NC), aimed at streamlining Medicare coverage for certain medical devices.
items.curatedReason: 这份 CMS 公告草案事关医疗器械的医保覆盖路径。如果最终通过，它将简化新设备的审批和报销流程，对提供相关创新物理治疗器械的诊所和医院将是利好，但暂时仍处于征求意见阶段。
items.titleZh: CMS 就医疗器械可预测和即时覆盖路径的监管协调征求意见
items.summaryZh: 美国医保与医助服务中心（CMS）发布程序性通知，就“医疗器械可预测和即时覆盖路径的监管协调”（CMS-3487-NC）征求公众意见，旨在简化部分医疗器械的医保覆盖流程。
items.curatedReasonEn: This draft CMS notice concerns the Medicare coverage pathway for medical devices. If finalized, it will streamline approval and reimbursement for new devices, benefiting clinics and hospitals that offer innovative physical therapy devices. However, it is currently in the public comment phase.

items.title: Supreme Court seeks compliance affidavits on Allied Healthcare Professions Act implementation
items.summary: The Indian Supreme Court has ordered the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions and state governments to file compliance affidavits on the implementation of the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions Act, 2021.
items.curatedReason: 印度最高法院要求国家专职医疗与健康专业委员会以及各邦政府提交宣誓书，详细说明《2021 年国家专职医疗与健康专业法案》的实施进展。这表明印度政府正在积极推动相关法律的落地，对在印度执业的物理治疗师来说，这意味着执业环境的规范化和标准化，你需要持续关注其进展。
items.titleZh: 印度最高法院要求提交《专职医疗与健康专业法案》实施宣誓书
items.summaryZh: 印度最高法院已下令国家专职医疗与健康专业委员会及各邦政府提交宣誓书，说明《2021 年国家专职医疗与健康专业法案》的实施情况。
items.curatedReasonEn: The Indian Supreme Court has mandated the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions and state governments to submit affidavits detailing the implementation of the National Commission for Allied and Healthcare Professions Act, 2021. This indicates that the Indian government is actively promoting the enactment of relevant laws. For physical therapists practicing in India, this signifies the standardization and normalization of the practice environment, and you need to continue to monitor its progress.

items.title: Article - Billing and Coding: MolDX: Molecular Syndromic Panels for Infectious Disease Pathogen Identification Testing (A58720)
items.summary: A draft article from CMS discusses billing and coding for MolDX: Molecular Syndromic Panels for Infectious Disease Pathogen Identification Testing (A58720), indicating potential policy updates in diagnostic test reimbursement.
items.curatedReason: 这份 CMS 草案文章涉及分子诊断面板的编码和计费，虽然与物理治疗核心业务无直接关系，但它反映了美国医疗保险在精细化诊断测试上的政策动向。作为诊所所有者，你需要关注这类政策变化，了解未来诊断环节可能对你执业环境产生的影响。
items.titleZh: CMS 计费和编码草案：MolDX 感染性疾病分子诊断面板
items.summaryZh: CMS 发布了一份关于 MolDX 感染性疾病分子诊断面板（A58720）的计费和编码草案，预示着诊断测试报销政策可能更新。
items.curatedReasonEn: This CMS draft article on coding and billing for molecular syndromic panels is not directly related to core physical therapy services. Still, it reflects policy trends in US Medicare for refined diagnostic testing. As a clinic owner, you need to monitor such policy changes to understand the potential impact of future diagnostic developments on your practice environment.

items.title: Data access and research
items.summary: The Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) outlines its policies for data access and research, providing guidelines for accessing information on registered health practitioners.
items.curatedReason: AHPRA 的这份文件解释了其数据获取和研究政策，详细说明了如何获取澳大利亚卫生执业者的注册信息。如果你在澳大利亚从事研究或希望了解当地物理治疗专业人士的公开信息，这份指南至关重要。
items.titleZh: 澳大利亚医疗执业者监管机构 (AHPRA) 数据获取与研究政策
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚医疗执业者监管机构（AHPRA）阐述了其数据获取和研究政策，为查询注册医疗执业者信息提供了指南。
items.curatedReasonEn: This AHPRA document explains its data access and research policies, detailing how to obtain information on registered health practitioners in Australia. If you are conducting research or seeking public information on physical therapy professionals in Australia, this guide is crucial.

items.title: External validation of the minimal important change in the Berg Balance Scale scores of patients hospitalized for subacute stroke.
items.summary: A longitudinal study of 286 subacute stroke patients validated minimal important change (MIC) values for the Berg Balance Scale (BBS), confirming that ≥2, ≥5, and ≥9-point thresholds are consistent across walking-ability subgroups.
items.curatedReason: 本研究验证了亚急性卒中患者 Berg 平衡量表 (BBS) 最小重要改变值的外推性。在临床评估和疗效判断时，可参考 ≥2、≥5 和 ≥9 分的阈值，这些值在不同步行能力亚组中也表现出一致性，为你的康复目标设定提供了更坚实的依据。
items.titleZh: 亚急性卒中住院患者 Berg 平衡量表最小重要改变值的外验证
items.summaryZh: 一项针对 286 例亚急性卒中患者的纵向研究验证了 Berg 平衡量表 (BBS) 的最小重要改变值 (MIC)，结果显示 ≥2、≥5 和 ≥9 分的阈值在不同步行能力亚组中均表现出一致性。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study validates the generalizability of minimal important change (MIC) values for the Berg Balance Scale (BBS) in subacute stroke patients. When assessing clinical outcomes, you can confidently refer to the ≥2, ≥5, and ≥9 point thresholds, as they demonstrate consistency across different walking ability subgroups, providing a more robust basis for your rehabilitation goal setting.
items.limitation: 研究为单中心观察性研究，可能存在一定的选择偏倚，且不同步行能力亚组间的样本量差异可能影响结果的普遍性。
items.limitationEn: This was a single-center observational study, which may introduce selection bias, and differences in sample sizes among walking ability subgroups could impact the generalizability of the findings.
items.journal: Archives of physical medicine and rehabilitation

items.title: Short-term inspiratory muscle training, aerobic exercise, and detraining in women with COPD: a randomized controlled trial
items.summary: A randomized controlled trial investigated the effects of short-term inspiratory muscle training, aerobic exercise, and detraining in women with COPD.
items.curatedReason: 这项随机对照试验表明，短期吸气肌训练和有氧运动对慢阻肺（COPD）女性患者有效，即使停训后仍有一定益处，为你将这些干预纳入 COPD 康复计划提供了实践依据。
items.titleZh: 短期吸气肌训练、有氧运动及停训对慢阻肺女性患者的影响：一项随机对照试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机对照试验研究了短期吸气肌训练、有氧运动及停训对慢阻肺（COPD）女性患者的影响。
items.curatedReasonEn: This randomized controlled trial shows that short-term inspiratory muscle training and aerobic exercise are effective for women with COPD, with some benefits persisting after detraining, providing practical evidence for you to incorporate these interventions into COPD rehabilitation programs.
items.limitation: 研究对象为女性 COPD 患者，结果对男性患者或不同疾病严重程度的患者外推时需谨慎。
items.limitationEn: The study involved female COPD patients, so results should be extrapolated with caution to male patients or those with different disease severities.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Altered inter-joint coordination strategies of the lower extremity and pelvis in elite rowers with chronic low back pain
items.summary: This study investigated altered inter-joint coordination strategies of the lower extremity and pelvis in elite rowers experiencing chronic low back pain, identifying specific biomechanical differences.
items.curatedReason: 精英赛艇运动员的慢性腰痛可能与特定的下肢和骨盆协调策略改变有关。在评估这类患者时，你应当关注其生物力学模式，这提示我们康复干预可能需要更精细的生物力学分析。
items.titleZh: 精英赛艇运动员慢性腰痛时下肢和骨盆的关节间协调策略改变
items.summaryZh: 这项研究调查了患有慢性腰痛的精英赛艇运动员下肢和骨盆关节间协调策略的改变，识别了特定的生物力学差异。
items.curatedReasonEn: This study reveals altered lower extremity and pelvic coordination strategies in elite rowers with chronic low back pain, helping you understand biomechanical compensation patterns in this specific athletic population.
items.limitation: 本研究为观察性研究，样本量和数据分析方法未在摘要中明确提及，无法确定因果关系。
items.limitationEn: This is an observational study; sample size and data analysis methods were not specified in the abstract, limiting the ability to determine causality.
items.journal: BMC Sports Science, Medicine and Rehabilitation

items.title: Low‐intensity focused ultrasound neuromodulation for drug‐resistant epilepsy: A randomized, sham‐controlled crossover trial
items.summary: A randomized, sham-controlled crossover trial found low-intensity focused ultrasound neuromodulation safe and well tolerated for drug-resistant epilepsy, with delayed seizure reduction suggesting potential sustained effects, though primary analysis lacked statistical significance.
items.curatedReason: 这项 RCT 虽未在主要分析中显示统计学显著性，但证实低强度聚焦超声神经调控治疗难治性癫痫是安全的且耐受性良好。此外，其提示的延迟性癫痫发作减少值得你持续关注，这可能意味着治疗存在潜在的持续效应，仍有进一步研究的价值。
items.titleZh: 低强度聚焦超声神经调控治疗难治性癫痫：一项随机、假对照交叉试验
items.summaryZh: 一项随机、假对照交叉试验发现，低强度聚焦超声神经调控治疗难治性癫痫安全且耐受性良好，虽主要分析未达统计学显著性，但延迟性癫痫发作减少提示其潜在的持续效应。
items.curatedReasonEn: While this RCT did not show statistical significance in its primary analysis, it confirms that low-intensity focused ultrasound neuromodulation for drug-resistant epilepsy is safe and well-tolerated. Furthermore, the suggested delayed seizure reduction is worth your continued attention, as it may imply potential sustained effects, meriting further research.
items.limitation: 主要交叉分析未显示统计学显著疗效，且需要更大规模、更长随访期的平行组试验来证实延迟效应和长期疗效。
items.limitationEn: The primary crossover analysis did not show statistically significant efficacy, and larger parallel-group trials with longer observation periods are needed to confirm delayed effects and long-term efficacy.

items.title: Network analysis of frailty, sleep quality, and life satisfaction in older patients: a cross-sectional study stratified by chronic disease burden
items.summary: This cross-sectional study used network analysis to examine the interplay of frailty, sleep quality, and life satisfaction in older patients, stratified by chronic disease burden.
items.curatedReason: 这项基于网络分析的横断面研究揭示了老年患者衰弱、睡眠质量和生活满意度之间的复杂关联，特别是在不同慢性病负担下，有助于你更全面地理解老年综合征。
items.titleZh: 老年患者衰弱、睡眠质量和生活满意度的网络分析：一项按慢性病负担分层的横断面研究
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究采用网络分析法，探讨了老年患者衰弱、睡眠质量和生活满意度之间的相互作用，并根据慢性病负担进行了分层。
items.curatedReasonEn: This network analysis-based cross-sectional study reveals complex associations between frailty, sleep quality, and life satisfaction in older patients, especially under varying chronic disease burdens, helping you to understand geriatric syndromes more comprehensively.
items.limitation: 本研究为横断面设计，无法建立因果关系，且可能存在未测量混杂因素。
items.limitationEn: This study's cross-sectional design prevents establishing causality, and unmeasured confounding factors may exist.

items.title: Development of the football tactical skills scale and comparison of scores across player and training characteristics
items.summary: This study describes the development of a football tactical skills scale and compares scores across player and training characteristics.
items.curatedReason: 本研究提出了足球战术技能量表的开发和应用，为你评估运动员战术表现提供了潜在工具，但其临床转化价值仍需更多验证。
items.titleZh: 足球战术技能量表的开发及在不同球员和训练特征间的比较
items.summaryZh: 本研究描述了足球战术技能量表的开发，并比较了不同球员和训练特征间的得分。
